title: stream.export request

cache_scope.description: Base-analysis cache scope. full (default) is reusable by query, export, and dynamic validate; range requires a non-empty time_range and caches only that one-off normalized interval.

channel.description: 协议或 stream 的逻辑 channel 选择；可用值由本 action 的 enum 决定。

kind.description: 导出或查询的结果类型。

line_limit.description: Limits returned evidence rows only, not scanning, aggregation, or the verdict; read completeness fields as well.

path.description: Artifact path; omit it to return an in-response preview.

allOf.description: Export destination and rendering controls. path, file_format, and verbose are supported only where this action declares them.

output.description: Export destination and rendering controls. path, file_format, and verbose are supported only where this action declares them.

render_time_unit.description: Controls only canonical response time rendering: auto, ps, ns, or us. It never changes input parsing, sampling, filtering, or ordering.

stream.description: 已加载的 stream 配置名称。

begin.description: 闭区间起点；省略时使用可用波形窗口起点。

end.description: 闭区间终点；省略时使用可用波形窗口终点。

time_range.description: Closed analysis interval. begin and end may be omitted independently to use the available waveform bounds.

value_format.description: 返回 LogicValue 的显示格式；不改变比较、采样或底层四态值。

timeout_ms.description: Positive public frontend-to-engine request timeout in milliseconds. Omit limits.timeout_ms to disable the public watchdog.

description: Export stream transfers or packet data from an explicit full or range base-cache scope.
x-purpose: 导出 stream 查询结果。
x-how_it_works: 按 kind/format 从 query/dynamic validate 共用的 full/range base 写出；kind 只能是 transfer、packet、packet_beats。
x-when_to_use: 把流数据输出给外部脚本并避免重复扫描。
x-arg_contract_notes: required: stream; cache_scope: full(default) / range; kind: transfer / packet / packet_beats; format: tsv / csv / xout; when kind=packet_beats: output
x-description-zh: 从显式 full 或 range 基础分析缓存范围导出 stream 查询结果。

use_when: Export stream transfers or packet data while reusing an explicit full/range base analysis.
do_not_use_when: Do not use it when no artifact/preview export is required or when applying interactive query filters.

alternatives.when: Return filtered stream evidence in the response.

constraints: required: stream; cache_scope: full(default) / range; kind: transfer / packet / packet_beats; format: tsv / csv / xout; when kind=packet_beats: output
